meta.purpose: Persistent brand, product, business and advertising knowledge base for the Vaylo Ad Studio AI strategist and campaign tools.
meta.status: editable source of truth — not a temporary prompt

company.name: Vaylo Sports
company.category: All-sports training, performance improvement and athlete development application
company.product_type: Digital sports technology product, primarily a mobile application, with a web application version also being developed
company.core_purpose: Help athletes understand their performance, train more intelligently, improve their sporting ability, and make better training decisions
company.slogan: Learn smarter. Train better. Perform better.
company.long_term_vision: Build a recognised sports technology brand that helps athletes improve across different sports and disciplines
company.positioning: Premium, modern, ambitious sports technology platform

brand_positioning.identity: Serious sports technology company operating in the sports industry
notes: A professional and credible athlete experience
avoid: Vague claims about innovation or artificial intelligence

primary_logo.status: SUPPLIED — this is the official Vaylo Sports logo. Use this artwork. Never generate, re-trace or approximate a stand-in.
primary_logo.mark: A stylised brain drawn as a single continuous outline, with a short stem descending from its base. No wordmark, no lettering and no tagline inside the artwork.
primary_logo.appearance: A blue-to-purple gradient outline on a solid black background.

colours.direction: Blue at the upper left graduating to purple at the lower right

assets.role: source of truth for the artwork — in-app brand mark (sidebar and header)
app icon — browser favicon, apple-touch-icon and social preview in the app shell
assets.note: Extracted from the 256px PNG payload already inside public/favicon.ico, so it is the same official artwork, just in a size and format browsers and iOS accept directly

assets.role: marketing site favicon, apple-touch-icon, Organization schema logo, header and footer mark

usage_rules: Never redraw, re-trace, recolour, re-gradient, add glow, add outline or add effects to the mark
Never place the mark on a light or mid-tone background — the supplied artwork is drawn to sit on dark navy/black only
Never stretch, squash or crop the mark; scale it proportionally and keep it square
Keep clear space of at least 25% of the mark's height on every side
Minimum legible sizes: 16px favicon, 24px in-app, 48px on video and picture-ad end cards
Do not combine the mark with a wordmark, drop shadow, stroke or frame
Do not present an AI-generated lookalike as the Vaylo logo
primary_logo.creative_note: The mark is a brain, which reads as intelligence rather than sport. Creative must not lean on AI/brain visual metaphors: the brand has to read as multi-sport athlete technology, not as a generic AI startup. The logo itself stays exactly as supplied.

visual_brand_identity.logo_rule: Do not redraw, distort, recolour or replace the official logo without authorisation
styling: Sharp compositions and clear visual hierarchy
avoid: Generic AI-generated people with distorted anatomy
Visuals that make the brand appear like a gaming or cryptocurrency company

target_audience.description: People who train regularly, participate in organised sport, compete recreationally or seriously, and want to improve their performance
segments: Amateur athletes who want better training guidance
Athletes who struggle to organise their training
Athletes who want to understand their performance and progress
Athletes looking for personalised training recommendations
Athletes who use technology to support their sporting development
Athletes returning to structured training after a break
Athletes who want a more organised approach to long-term development
target_audience.segmentation_note: These are marketing hypotheses, not proven customer segments. The strategist must test which audiences respond best.
target_audience.diversity_rule: Do not assume that all athletes have the same needs. Use different sports and audience segments across the advertising portfolio. Make every example relevant to the advertised message.
target_audience.younger_users_rule: Any advertising aimed at younger users must comply with applicable privacy, consumer protection, platform and advertising rules. The intended core market remains 18–30.

problems: Athletes do not know how to structure their training
Generic plans may not reflect an individual's needs
Athletes struggle to understand whether they are progressing
Athletes may not know how to adapt after missed sessions or interruptions
Athletes may struggle to turn goals into a practical plan
Sports information can be fragmented across different tools
Athletes may need help understanding their training history and next steps
motivations: Make better use of training time
Feel more confident in training decisions
customer_problems_and_motivations.truth_rule: Never claim that Vaylo solves a problem unless its current functionality actually supports that claim.

product_features.advertising_rule: Only VERIFIED features may be advertised as currently available

current_candidate_features.name: Personal bests and performance information where supported

product_features.future_label_rule: These future directions must remain clearly marked as planned unless the current product demonstrably supports them.
product_features.integration_rule: Do not advertise Google Fit, Garmin, COROS, Apple Health, WHOOP, Oura or other integrations as available unless the integration is implemented and working.
claims_boundary: Do not claim that Vaylo can diagnose injuries
Do not claim that Vaylo can replace a qualified coach
Do not claim that Vaylo can guarantee performance improvements
Do not claim that Vaylo can prevent injuries
product_features.missing_information_rule: When product details are missing, ask for verified information or use placeholders in drafts until the claims can be checked.

product_demonstration_rules.priority: Authentic product demonstrations should be a major part of Vaylo's advertising
product_demonstration_rules.analysis_rule: When real app footage is provided, the AI should inspect it, identify its useful sections, and recommend how to incorporate them into an advert.
prohibited: Do not invent interface elements, charts, statistics or features and portray them as real Vaylo screens
AI-generated mock-ups may be used for conceptual work, but they must not be misrepresented as the current application

order_of_importance: Generate genuine interest from the target audience
Build a waitlist or other pre-launch audience if that mechanism is available
Drive qualified users to the appropriate landing page or app listing
Convert interested people into installs and registrations when the product is available
Learn which audiences, messages and features create the strongest results
Build a repeatable and affordable acquisition system

launch_date.note: Treat this as the current intended launch date, not a guarantee. Make it editable in the campaign settings and ask for an update if the schedule changes.

business_objectives.pre_launch_rule: Before launch, do not use CTAs such as 'Download now' or 'Available now' unless the relevant product is actually available to the intended audience.
business_objectives.post_launch_rule: After launch, use the actual app-store listing or supported acquisition destination.

marketing_budget_and_constraints.default_assumption: The initial marketing strategy should prioritise organic distribution, reusable creative assets, free opportunities and very low-cost production.
marketing_budget_and_constraints.budget_assumption: Assume there is little or no initial advertising budget unless the setting is changed.
marketing_budget_and_constraints.objective: Maximise useful reach, qualified interest and learning per pound spent.
not_assumed: The company has an advertising agency
The company has a paid production team
The company has an unlimited media budget
marketing_budget_and_constraints.operating_model: Design workflows that allow one person to manage the majority of campaign production.
priorities: Multiple edits from the same source assets
Picture ads where video is unnecessary
Referral and community strategies where appropriate
marketing_budget_and_constraints.organic_rule: Never assume that free reach is guaranteed. Organic distribution is unpredictable and requires testing.
marketing_budget_and_constraints.spend_separation: Separate production spending from paid advertising spend. The platform must track both when the relevant data is available.

advertising_channels.selection_rule: The strategist should select channels based on the audience, creative format, campaign objective and available resources.
candidate_channels: Partnerships with coaches and sporting organisations
Other channels that become appropriate as evidence develops
advertising_channels.channel_rule: Do not automatically recommend every channel for every campaign.
advertising_channels.per_channel_requirement: For each proposed channel, identify the intended audience, format, publishing requirements, CTA and measurement method.
advertising_channels.publish_rule: Do not publish advertisements automatically without explicit authorisation and the required integrations.

ad_creative_strategy.rule: The strategist must create advertisements that communicate one primary idea at a time.
frameworks: Strong hook → relatable athlete situation → benefit → CTA
Myth or misconception → useful insight → relevant Vaylo feature
Athlete goal → training challenge → supported product solution
Comparison of disorganised and structured training, without misleading claims
A day in an athlete's training routine
Educational content that provides genuine value
A short cinematic sports opening followed by an authentic product demonstration
Brand story and founder-led messaging where suitable
ad_creative_strategy.frameworks_note: These are creative options, not mandatory templates.
ad_creative_strategy.variation_rule: Do not make every advertisement follow the same formula.
ad_creative_strategy.concept_rule: For each campaign, generate three genuinely different concepts rather than three minor variations of the same video.
ad_creative_strategy.prediction_note: Treat predicted performance as an estimate, not a fact.

hooks_and_execution.goal: The opening seconds should make the intended audience understand why the advert is relevant.
hook_approaches: A useful insight that challenges a common assumption
hooks_and_execution.language_rule: Use natural language that athletes would understand.
hooks_and_execution.focus_rule: Do not cram multiple product benefits into a short advert. Focus on one main benefit and one clear CTA.
hooks_and_execution.caption_rule: Use captions that remain readable on mobile screens. Keep important text and logos within the appropriate safe areas for the target platform.

video_advertising_rules.length_rule: Create a variety of video lengths and formats based on the purpose of each campaign.
video_advertising_rules.starting_points_note: These are starting points, not universal platform requirements.
video_advertising_rules.ai_video_rule: Use AI-generated video when it adds value, but do not generate every scene automatically.
production_process: Select or upload appropriate source footage
Identify which scenes genuinely need generated visuals
Add real Vaylo interface footage where appropriate
Create narration if it improves the message
Add captions, logo, music and CTA
video_advertising_rules.text_rule: Avoid generating text inside footage when the text can be overlaid accurately during editing.
video_advertising_rules.truth_rule: Do not show invented app functionality or imply that AI-generated athletes are real Vaylo customers.

visual_hierarchy: One concise supporting point if needed
picture_advertising_rules.screenshot_rule: Use authentic screenshots when the purpose is to demonstrate the product.
picture_advertising_rules.generated_image_rule: Use generated sports imagery when it improves the concept and does not falsely imply an endorsement or real customer experience.
picture_advertising_rules.variation_rule: Create variations for different audience segments and messages, not simply different background colours.
picture_advertising_rules.export_check: Check spelling, contrast, readability, logo integrity and platform dimensions before exporting.

voice_music_and_sound.voice_provider: Use ElevenLabs for narration when connected and suitable.
voice_music_and_sound.voice_rule: The voice should fit the audience and campaign. It should sound clear, credible and natural rather than exaggerated or artificially enthusiastic.
voice_music_and_sound.sound_design_rule: Use sound design selectively. Do not let music overpower narration or distract from the message.
voice_music_and_sound.rights_rule: Use only music and sound effects with appropriate commercial usage rights.
voice_music_and_sound.alternatives: Allow text-only and silent versions when appropriate.

competitive_positioning.goal: Help differentiate Vaylo from general fitness apps, individual-sport apps, training-plan libraries, wearable dashboards and coaching products.
competitive_positioning.competitor_rule: Do not automatically describe competitors as inferior.
competitive_positioning.evidence_rule: Competitor information must be current and evidence-based when it is used in campaigns.
competitive_positioning.ip_rule: Do not copy competitor creative assets, slogans, proprietary content or distinctive branding.

testing_and_measurement.purpose: The platform must help learn what works, not merely create attractive adverts.
testing_and_measurement.per_campaign_requirement: For every campaign, record its objective and intended KPI before launch.
candidate_metrics: Cost per acquisition where paid spend exists
testing_and_measurement.metric_rule: Do not confuse views with business success.
testing_and_measurement.interpretation_note: A video that gets many views but no relevant clicks or registrations may be less useful than a smaller campaign that attracts genuine users.
testing_and_measurement.testing_rule: Recommend testing one or two meaningful variables at a time, such as the hook, audience, visual style or CTA.
testing_and_measurement.record_rule: Record the results and use them to inform future recommendations.
testing_and_measurement.causation_rule: Do not claim causation or statistical significance when the evidence does not support it.

compliance_and_trust.overarching_rule: All creative must be truthful, transparent and compliant with applicable laws and platform rules.
prohibited: Unauthorised use of people's likenesses or voices
required: Respect relevant privacy, consent and advertising requirements
Clearly distinguish fictional demonstrations from real customer experiences where necessary
compliance_and_trust.medical_rule: Do not imply that Vaylo diagnoses, treats or prevents medical conditions unless the product has the necessary substantiation and authorisation.
